paragraphs: Sandra Lambatos testified that the side that brought the case's DNA matched a profile. She described results generated by Cellmark analysts. No Cellmark analyst appeared at the trial. the side that brought the case argues this violates the Confrontation Clause. The state argues the testimony was permissible.
